messages:
zoe_support: Heads-up: SafeHouse reported AWS Marketplace invoice shows ~1.9M tokens billed for Mar 12, but our dashboard shows ~980k. Customer says they're being double-charged. AWS invoice has two separate line items referencing the same product SKU. Opening thread to triage. Case: AWS #1234567891. @mike_billing can you pull metering logs?

mike_billing: On it. Do we have the marketplace entitlement IDs from SafeHouse? We should join on entitlement_id not sku/account.

zoe_support: Customer provided entitlements: ent-0a1b2c3d (account A) and ent-0a1b2c3d (account B) — looks like same entitlement ID issued per account during migration. They also said they have consolidated billing across two AWS accounts.

anya_eng: Quick hypothesis: our reconciler dedup key is (sku, date) which means if the same entitlement shows up across accounts we count both. We need to change to (marketplace_entitlement_id, hour_bucket) or collapse by distinct usage_event_id. Repro steps:
1) pull raw metering events (s3://redwood-metering/raw/2026-03-12/)
2) run: aws s3 ls s3://redwood-metering/raw/2026-03-12/ --recursive
3) run query:

```sql
SELECT entitlement_id, count(distinct usage_event_id) as events, sum(tokens) as tokens
FROM marketplace_metering
WHERE date = '2026-03-12'
GROUP BY entitlement_id;
```

This shows two sets of events that map to the same entitlement_id but different aws_account_id.

raj_ops: Checked reconciler logs. Last agg run (2026-03-13 00:05 UTC) shows two aggregated rows for the customer with identical entitlement_id but different aws_account. Both were forwarded to billing. Patch plan: change dedupe key, backfill Mar 10-13, and re-emit corrected lineitems to marketplace aggregator.

mike_billing: We should issue a provisional credit while this is resolved — customer expects same-day. Raising finance ticket now. Also opened follow-up with AWS support to confirm which line item maps to which entitlement. AWS case updated -> 1234567899 :white_check_mark:

zoe_support: Customer OK with credit + reconciled invoice. They've uploaded hourly CSV to Zendesk #98765. I'll attach once backfill results are ready. Thanks :thumbsup:

anya_eng: I'll draft a PR to reconciler to dedupe on marketplace_entitlement_id + hour window and to prefer distinct(usage_event_id) when summing tokens. Draft SQL in PR and unit tests to simulate dual-account entitlement. ETA EOD.

raj_ops: Deploying hotfix to staging and running backfill for Mar 10-13. Running sanity diff against our dashboard to compute delta. Log tail:

```
[2026-03-13 03:12:08] backfill: processed 1,240,321 events, deduped 1,179,450
[2026-03-13 03:21:15] backfill: corrected_token_sum for SafeHouse: 980,412 (was 1,902,233)
```

aws-marketplace-bot: AWS Support case 1234567899 updated: "Confirmed duplicate entitlements across linked accounts; recommended seller request entitlement consolidation or report per-entitlement usage." https://console.aws.amazon.com/support/cases#1234567899

mike_billing: Action items: finance issues credit to SafeHouse for the overcharge (amount TBD), ops to run backfill and re-emit corrected invoice lines, eng to land PR + production deploy. Assigning to @anya_eng and @raj_ops. I'll coordinate with sales for customer comms.

zoe_support: Thanks team. I'll keep the customer updated and close this thread after credit is applied and they confirm. :handshake
